Job Title: Data Engineer

 About Us

“Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the  British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by Avtar & Seramount. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery. 

WHY JOIN CAPCO?

You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.

MAKE AN IMPACT

Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.

#BEYOURSELFATWORK

Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.

CAREER ADVANCEMENT

With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.

MAKE AN IMPACT

Role Description

Experience : 10-12 Years

Job Location : Bangalore/Pune/Hyderabad

Notice Period: 0 - 30 days

JD:

Role : 

  • Key Responsibilities

    · Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud-native data pipelines for trade lifecycle data processing.

    · Develop and optimize ETL/ELT workflows for ingesting, transforming, and loading high-volume financial datasets.

    · Create and maintain robust data models and schema designs aligned to trade lifecycle (front-to-back processing).

    · Onboard and integrate DTCC data sources, including RTTM and Settlement Web, into a Unified Trade Record (UTR) schema.

    · Design and implement ingestion frameworks using messaging systems (MQ) and API-based data extraction.

    · Process and normalize financial messages, including ISO 15022 formats.

    · Populate and maintain Trade Exceptions databases, ensuring accuracy and consistency of exception workflows.

    · Collaborate with business stakeholders (operations, reconciliation, settlements teams) to align data structures with business processes.

    · Optimize SQL Server queries, indexing strategies, and database performance.

    · Work with AWS cloud-native data services (e.g., S3, EKS (Kubernetes/Docker), RDS) for scalable data solutions.

    · Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, and observability across pipelines.

    · Troubleshoot complex data issues and provide analytical insights into trade discrepancies and exceptions.

    Required Skills & Qualifications

    · 10+ years of experience in data engineering, with a strong focus on capital markets.

    · Deep understanding of trade lifecycle (execution, clearing, settlement, reconciliation).

    · Strong experience with ETL/ELT frameworks and large-scale data processing.

    · Expertise in data modeling and schema design, particularly for trade and transaction data.

    · Hands-on experience with DTCC data sources, especially RTTM and Settlement Web.

    · Strong knowledge of ISO 15022 message formats and financial data standards.

    · Experience building ingestion frameworks using MQ (e.g., IBM MQ, Kafka) and REST APIs.

    · Advanced SQL skills with strong experience in SQL Server (performance tuning, indexing, stored procedures).

    · Experience with AWS cloud-native data platforms and services.

    · Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

    Preferred Qualifications

    · Experience with unified data models such as Unified Trade Record (UTR) and Schema development and Trade Exceptions management experience.

    · Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and cataloging tools.

    · Experience with real-time or near-real-time data processing frameworks.

    · Knowledge of regulatory reporting and compliance requirements in capital markets.

    · Knowing FIX messages and processing FxML messages will be an add-on experience.

    · Prior consulting or client-facing experience.

    Soft Skills

    · Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

    · Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.

    · Ability to work independently and in collaborative environments.

    · Proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

 

If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
